title: WAFA reports Palestinian killed and several injured in Gaza attacks
summary_or_snippet: WAFA reported on October 25 that a Palestinian was killed and several others were injured in an Israeli bombardment of the Sheikh Nasser neighborhood east of Khan Younis. The report also described additional injuries in Jabalia refugee camp and near al-Maghazi refugee camp.
